project_info.title: LOCK CITY V2 — Immersive Streetwear & Lifestyle E-Commerce Prototype
project_info.concept: THE CITY IS ALIVE. A digital place where collections are DISTRICTS, products are OBJECTS, releases are DROPS, past releases live in the ARCHIVE, editorial content is TRANSMISSIONS, and community is PEOPLE OF THE CITY.
project_info.tone: Urban, sophisticated, experimental, premium, youthful, editorial, architectural, slightly raw, minimal but strong

colors.accent: PURE MONOCHROME — No colored accents permitted
rules: Strict pure monochrome palette: #050505 background, #F1EFE9 bone-white primary text, #222222 graphite borders/dividers, #747474 steel muted accents, #101010 secondary dark surfaces.
NEVER use colored accents (no neon blues, purples, oranges, or teals).
Use #F1EFE9 on #222222 or #050505 with minimum 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG contrast ratio.
Hover states must use explicit color overrides: hover:bg-[#F1EFE9] hover:text-[#050505] for primary CTAs.

typography.display_font: Unbounded, Syne, or Anton / Oswald (fallback: uppercase sans-serif with tracking-tighter and font-black for architectural display headers)
typography.utility_font: Space Mono or JetBrains Mono / Inter (fallback: system monospace or geometric sans for technical specs, prices, STATUS: AVAILABLE labels)

styles.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none text-[#F1EFE9]
styles.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight leading-tight text-[#F1EFE9]
styles.h3_card: text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#F1EFE9]
styles.utility_label: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#747474]

anti_patterns: Do NOT use default Inter for main architectural headings or hero titles.
Do NOT use soft cursive or decorative script fonts.
Do NOT mix more than 2 distinct font families.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing philosophy. Use 2x-3x padding to give architectural breathing room.

grid_modes.bento_tetris: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-10
grid_modes.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8

spacing_and_layout.border_rules: All containers with borders must include internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to eliminate text collision.

webgl_and_3d_experience.engine: Three.js / React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber) + Drei (@react-three/drei) + Canvas API procedural fallback
webgl_and_3d_experience.theme: Abstract brutalist architectural wireframes, volumetric fog (#050505), particle grids, directional light beams, monochrome lighting
features: Scene 01 Enter The City: 3D procedural brutalist monoliths, floating metallic geometric grids, atmospheric particle dust, mouse-parallax tilt
Scene 04 Districts Spatial Interaction: Interactive 3D architectural quadrant selector (DISTRICT 01 CORE, 02 DROP, 03 COLLAB, 04 ARCHIVE) with raycasting hover tilt and camera zoom
Scene 05 Featured Object: 3D rotating product wireframe / silhouette cube / technical blueprint projection with scroll-linked rotation
performance: Pause rendering when WebGL canvas is offscreen using IntersectionObserver
Mobile complexity reduction: disable heavy post-processing and reduce particle count to 250 on screen widths < 768px
Graceful fallback to procedural HTML5 Canvas 2D grid/noise shader if WebGL is unsupported or reduced-motion is requested

homepage_scenes.name: Initialization Loader
homepage_scenes.description: Full-screen system boot sequence with digital counter (0% -> 100%), technical telemetry, STATUS: SYSTEM_ONLINE, and masked unveil reveal animation.

homepage_scenes.name: Enter The City Cinematic Hero
homepage_scenes.description: Kinetic headline 'LOCK CITY®' with line-by-line reveal, live status badge [LOCATION: 37.7749° N | STATUS: LIVE], 3D WebGL background, CTA 'ENTER THE CITY' with hover invert effect.

homepage_scenes.name: Latest Drop Editorial
homepage_scenes.description: High-impact narrative layout announcing DROP_006 'URBAN MONOLITH'. Editorial typography, release countdown timestamp, technical spec callouts.

homepage_scenes.name: Shop The Drop
homepage_scenes.description: 4 to 6 mock OBJECT cards (e.g. OBJECT_0041 HEAVYWEIGHT HOODIE, OBJECT_0042 CARGO TROUSER). Clean architectural grid, quick-add drawer trigger, hovering tech blueprint overlay.

homepage_scenes.name: Districts Spatial Selector
homepage_scenes.description: Interactive spatial layout: DISTRICT 01 CORE, 02 DROP, 03 COLLAB, 04 ARCHIVE. Hover states reveal district metadata, item counts, and WebGL camera shifts.

homepage_scenes.name: Featured Object Storytelling
homepage_scenes.description: Scroll-reveal product deep dive for OBJECT_0041 ('BUILT FOR THE CITY'). Multi-stage pinned scroll sequence: Silhouette -> Graphic -> Material (500GSM Organic Cotton) -> Technical -> Identity -> Direct CTA.

homepage_scenes.name: The City (Manifesto Chapters)
homepage_scenes.description: Brand culture editorial with numbered manifesto chapters (01 / CONCRETE FOUNDATION, 02 / UNCOMPROMISING UTILITY, 03 / DIGITAL PERPETUITY). Slow editorial marquee ribbon.

homepage_scenes.name: People Of The City
homepage_scenes.description: Community spotlight section showcasing street culture styling, district coordinates, and citizen roster cards with subtle hover lift.

homepage_scenes.name: Archive Vault
homepage_scenes.description: Digital vault with system aesthetic: DROP_001 ARCHIVED, DROP_002 ARCHIVED, status tags, release dates, and vault detail modal trigger.

homepage_scenes.name: Transmissions
homepage_scenes.description: Editorial journal teasers with issue numbers (TRANSMISSION_012), publication dates, reading time, and link to /journal.

homepage_scenes.name: Join The City
homepage_scenes.description: Newsletter terminal input [ENTER CITIZEN EMAIL...], instant toast feedback via Sonner, system status badge (DEMO ONLY).

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling engine enabled on desktop
animations: Staggered entrance reveals using Framer Motion (initial: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 })
Kinetic headline text reveal with overflow-hidden clip mask
Marquee drift speed: ultra-slow 20s drift using react-fast-marquee or framer motion repeat
Hover transitions: use specific property transitions (e.g. transition-colors duration-200), NEVER transition: all
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with useReducedMotion check and provide instant non-animated fallbacks when prefers-reduced-motion is detected.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, cart triggers, close buttons, sliders) MUST include data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this design_guidelines.json completely before writing UI components.
2. Ensure all components use .js / .jsx file extensions in /app/frontend/src/.
3. Maintain strict monochrome visual palette: #050505 background, #F1EFE9 text, #222222 borders.
4. Implement all 11 Homepage scenes (00 through 10) plus all required routes (/, /shop, /collections/:slug, /product/:slug, /archive, /city, /journal).
5. Use Three.js / R3F for WebGL hero background, District 3D selector, and Featured Object wireframe viewer.
6. Include data-testid on every interactive element for automated test verification.
7. Implement Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion micro-interactions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating navigation.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like sharp brutalist rectangular buttons with hover invert color transitions.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
